title: ProofOfVisitCheckResponse
description: Agent service to web service: what Moderation in proof-only mode read off the Proof of Visit (spec 09). No decision: the web service decides accepted, pending or rejected, as for a proof sent with a Testimony.

proofOfVisit.description: Facts only, never a judgment and never the patient's name. Absent when the check did not run (model error, timeout or invalid output); the web service then sends the proof to the admin.
proofOfVisit.title: ProofOfVisitCheckExtraction

isProofOfVisit.description: A receipt, invoice or appointment card from a dental Provider.

proofDate.description: The date printed: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is printed.

clinicNameMatches.description: The model's fuzzy judgment that the clinic name on the proof is the typed name or Google's live name.
